lock_note: Provenance lock for every official source input this framework pins. Records the upstream URL, the exact version, a SHA-256 of the pinned copy on disk, and the date it was verified current against upstream. The daily drift-check workflow hash-compares the pinned copies against these upstreams; this file is the human-readable record of what the pins mean and where they came from. Update deliberately, in the same change that bumps a pin, and never by hand-editing a hash to make a check pass.

cr26_consolidated_rules.description: FedRAMP Consolidated Rules for 2026, the canonical machine-readable requirements dataset and source of truth for rule text, identifiers, force, class applicability, KSIs, and definitions.
cr26_consolidated_rules.notes: The official guidance site states AI agents and automation must use the machine-readable repositories, not the rendered HTML at fedramp.gov. Refreshed from 2026.07.14.01 to 2026.09.13.02: added timeframe range fields (timeframe_num_min/max on CCM-QTR-SAR), top-level timing on 6 rules, and the force-of-rule definitions FRD-MAY/MST/MNT/SHD/SNT; no rules added or removed. Refreshed from 2026.09.13.02 to 2026.10.05.01 (adopted 2026-10-08 by the drift workflow, AUD-F40 path): 4 rules changed, 0 added, 0 removed, 0 force changes, KSI set unchanged (46). FRC-CSO-JSN statement extended (public JSON MUST be supplied in a manner compatible with modern web frameworks) with two following_information items (CORS; Content-Type application/json and X-Content-Type-Options nosniff); CDS-CSO-PUB 'Link to Product Logo' item gained image-link requirements (transparent PNG preferred); FRC-CSF-RDY and VER-EVA-EPA wording ('following dates'; 'likely potential agency impact').

sdr_schema.description: Official FedRAMP Security Decision Record JSON schema.
sdr_schema.notes: FedRAMP edits schema files in place without renaming, so the filename proves nothing; the $schemaVersion inside is the real signal. The validator asserts this $id and $schemaVersion at the build gate.

common_definitions_schema.description: Official FedRAMP common-definitions JSON schema, referenced by the SDR schema.
common_definitions_schema.notes: Refreshed 0.3.0 -> 0.4.0 on 2026-09-26: upstream added a reusable $defs/contactInformation object (pointOfContactName, jobTitle, email, phone, companyWebsite; all required within the object). No existing definition changed, so every previously valid document stays valid.

cpo_schema.description: Official FedRAMP Certification Package Overview JSON schema (CPO-CSO-OVR).
cpo_schema.notes: Refreshed 0.1.4 -> 0.1.6 on 2026-09-26: upstream added an OPTIONAL top-level advisors array (items require only name). The required set (serviceIdentification, serviceProperties, contactInformation) is unchanged, so the generated CPO stays valid; build_cpo.py does not emit advisors until a provider supplies them.

ocr_schema.description: Official FedRAMP Ongoing Certification Report JSON schema (CCM-OCR-AVL).

incident_report_schema.description: Official FedRAMP Incident Report JSON schema (IEC-CSO-IIR/OIR/FIR).

significant_change_notification_schema.description: Official FedRAMP Significant Change Notification JSON schema (SCN family).

accepted_vulnerability_info_schema.description: Official FedRAMP Accepted Vulnerability Information JSON schema (VER family).

vulnerability_detail_report_schema.description: Official FedRAMP Vulnerability Detail Report JSON schema (VDR family).

nist_800_53.description: NIST SP 800-53 security and privacy control catalog. Used only for the KSI-to-related-control reverse index (traceability), never as a source of FedRAMP requirements.
nist_800_53.notes: Release 5.2.0 (Aug 27, 2025) added SA-15(13), SA-24, SI-02(07) and revised SI-07(12). This framework does not automatically add new 5.2.0 control relationships to FedRAMP KSIs; relationships come only from the CR26 dataset. The reverse index is FedRAMP-declared relatedness, not control-satisfaction equivalence.

nist_800_63.description: NIST Digital Identity Guidelines. CR26's July 14 update cites 'the most recent NIST Digital Identity Guidelines' rather than a fixed revision.
nist_800_63.notes: SP 800-63-4 is final and supersedes SP 800-63-3. New normative material must not cite 800-63-3 as current; a validator regression check guards against a stale reference.

cr26_rules_schema.description: Official FedRAMP Consolidated Rules JSON Schema; source of truth for the dataset structure. The pinned dataset is validated against this before any catalog is derived.
cr26_rules_schema.notes: Refreshed with the 2026.09.13.02 dataset: the structure schema now defines the mutually-exclusive timeframe_num vs timeframe_num_min/timeframe_num_max representations.
